mapper.select: SELECT id, phone_number, user_name, password, login_at, create_at, status FROM users WHERE phone_number = #{phoneNumber} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, phone_number AS phoneNumber, user_name AS userName, password, status FROM users WHERE phone_number = #{phoneNumber}
SELECT id, phone_number, user_name, login_at, create_at, status, email, timezone, notification_preferences FROM users WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET user_name = #{userName}, email = #{email}, timezone = #{timezone} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET notification_preferences = CAST(#{preferences} AS jsonb) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET password = #{password} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET phone_number = #{phoneNumber} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( user_name, phone_number, password, create_at, status ) VALUES( #{userName}, #{phoneNumber}, #{password}, #{createAt}, #{status} )
